name: Anyword
tagline: AI copywriting platform that scores how marketing copy is likely to perform.
description: Anyword generates marketing copy and gives each variation a predicted performance score based on its trained models and your own performance data. It is made by Keywee Inc. (d.b.a. Anyword), based in New York.
pros: Unlimited words on every paid plan
Predictive performance scores for copy variations
Chrome extension and plagiarism checker included from Starter
cons: No free plan; the 7-day trial is capped at 2,500 words
API access only on the custom-priced Enterprise plan
Starter includes 1 seat and a limited number of performance predictions

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Per account, 1 seat, 1 workspace. Unlimited words. 1 brand voice.

plans.name: Data-Driven
plans.notes: Per account, includes 3 seats and 5 workspaces. Extra seats up to 10 at $59/mo ($49/mo yearly). Unlimited words.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom pricing, billed yearly. Custom AI models, A/B testing, roles and permissions, priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. SSO, private LLM, custom integrations, full API access, dedicated customer success manager.

integrations: Ad platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, Google), CMS and CRM tools; custom integrations on Enterprise

name: Sudowrite
tagline: AI writing assistant built for fiction writers and novelists.
description: Sudowrite offers AI tools to write, rewrite, describe and expand fiction, with story-aware context, style matching and continuity across a series. Plans are credit-based, and higher tiers add developmental edits, line edits and beta reads.
pros: Tools designed for fiction (story context, series continuity)
Max plan rolls over unused credits for 12 months
cons: No free plan, only a free trial
Usage is capped by monthly credits
Developmental edits, line edits and beta reads require Professional or higher

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per account. 1,000,000 credits per month. Adds developmental edits, line edits and beta reads.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Per account. 2,000,000 credits per month; unused credits roll over for 12 months.

sources.label: sudowrite.com blog: Cost of writing a novel with AI (updated Oct 19, 2026)

name: Hypotenuse AI
tagline: AI content and product-data platform for ecommerce catalogs.
bestFor: Ecommerce teams writing product content at scale
description: Hypotenuse AI generates product descriptions, meta tags, category pages and other ecommerce copy, and enriches, tags and categorizes product data. It has grown into a product experience management platform with a built-in PIM, image tools and SEO features.
pros: Built for bulk ecommerce content and product data
Brand voice and SEO optimization on the Enterprise plan
Integrates with Shopify, Akeneo, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, NetSuite and others
cons: No public prices; both plans are quote-only
Brand voice and SEO are not listed on the Basic plan
Mainly aimed at ecommerce, not general writing

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Custom pricing. 1 seat. Product descriptions plus 20+ ecommerce content types, 40+ languages.

plans.name: Ecommerce Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Product data enrichment, bulk image editor, brand voice, SEO, custom PIM/ERP integrations, dedicated account manager.

integrations: Shopify, Akeneo, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, NetSuite, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Amazon
